channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Skiers hit the slopes at Killington for the season opener today. The mountain is rushing to make enough snow for the upcoming World Cup race. Other Vermont ski resorts plan to open over the next two weeks, weather permitting.

Seventy new benefit assisters have been trained in Vermont to help residents access benefits. This comes after federal cuts to programs like threeSquaresVT and Medicaid. Benefit assisters guide people through complex applications and paperwork.

New York will end free home gas hookups starting next month after Governor Kathy Hochul signed a new bill. This change follows several defeats for climate advocates. The new rules may complicate gas system installations for residents.

Vermont State University appointed Dr. Scott Thomas as its new Provost. He has over fifteen years of higher education leadership experience. Dr. Thomas will focus on expanding student opportunities and academic innovation.
